thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-06-08 present conflicting signals: escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East (Israel-Iran missile strikes driving oil price increases and broader macro caution) contrast with constructive semiconductor partnership headlines (Nvidia multi-year deals with SK Hynix and Naver for gigawatt-scale AI factories). Our existing portfolio already holds direct exposure to this semiconductor/tech theme via NVDA and XLK, balanced by broad equity core VTI and fixed-income ballast BND. With 4 positions (cap 6), largest single name well below the 35% cap, and $35.00 cash (~33% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor), our balanced mandate is well-positioned to absorb geopolitical volatility without forced rebalancing or chasing headlines.
